`config.json` and `state.json` are a real Cloud Hypervisor v55 snapshot of
a glidex VM (one vCPU, 1 GiB, a hyperstor root disk, the cloud-init seed,
one tap NIC), taken on a test node on 2026-11-28 for spec/33 SB1. Its ids
are replaced: VM `0f0f0f0f-1111-4222-8333-444455556666`, volume
`1111111111111111111111111111aaaa`, firmware image
`22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222`. The memory file is left out.
